item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Nandini looks at the diagram. Straight lines $JK$ and $LM$ cross at $P$. The marked angle $\angle JPL$ is $81^{\circ}$, and $r$ labels the angle vertically opposite $\angle JPL$.

Which claim correctly gives the measure of $r$?

options.A: $r = 99^{\circ}$, treating an adjacent angle on a straight line as if it were the vertically opposite angle.
options.B: $r = 81^{\circ}$, because vertically opposite angles at the same intersection are equal.
options.C: $r = 81^{\circ}$, because the angles may be called opposite angles that must sum to $180^{\circ}$.
options.D: $r = 81^{\circ}$, only because $81$ is already printed near the crossing.
